open_issues.title: Word Search production regression
open_issues.detail: A Word Search requested with the topic "Flower Parts" produces unrelated generic vocabulary (apple, banana, cherry, dragon, energy, forest, garden, harbor, island, jungle) instead of flower-part words. Root cause: services/product.py talks to OpenAI directly for Topic-mode Word Search instead of using the shared topic engine, and falls back to a hard-coded placeholder word list when that call fails (e.g. on Render, which has no working OpenAI key). Fix is written out and awaiting approval — see SESSION_HANDOFF_2026-09-11.md.
